outcome: spontaneous rupture of a vessel over a uterine fibroid
cohort: A 48-year-old female presented with sudden onset abdominal pain, found to have intraperitoneal hemorrhage due to a spurting vessel over a fundal subserosal uterine fibroid.
finding: A case of spontaneous rupture of a vessel over a subserosal uterine fibroid was presented, leading to life-threatening intraperitoneal hemorrhage requiring emergency total abdominal hysterectomy.
